title: The Hidden Reason You Talk to Yourself
desc: Why is there a voice in your head, and who is it talking to? A calm, sourced deep dive into inner speech: how children's out-loud chatter moves inside, what beeper studies caught people really thinking, people who barely have an inner voice, whether you hear the words when you read, how your brain turns its own voice down, when talking out loud helps, why explaining things to yourself makes you learn, the storyteller that invents reasons, the wandering mind, and the small word changes that calm the inner critic. Every claim comes from named studies, with the doubts left in. The second half is a slow guided wind-down that uses what we learned to quiet the voice, so you can listen until you drift off.
